ideas.pitch: A localized, lightweight LLM orchestrator running fully offline that acts as an assistant for reverse engineering and binary analysis without relying on expensive cloud APIs, aligning with H7CTF's anti-pay-to-win ethos.
ideas.title: Anti-Budget CTF Triage Copilot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets H7CTF 2026's core thesis: leveling the playing field against massive AI budgets by providing local, deterministic security reasoning assistance.

ideas.pitch: A zero-knowledge flag verification circuit that allows players to prove they computed the correct flag hash or solved a binary challenge without leaking their exploit methodology or payload to other competitors during live rankings.
ideas.title: ZK-Proof Auth for Capture The Flag Submissions
ideas.why_it_could_win: Brings advanced cryptography and zero-knowledge principles into a competitive CTF landscape, matching the hard engineering pattern seen in top hackathon wins.

ideas.pitch: An automated memory dump and disk image forensics tool that correlates file system metadata with volatile RAM artifacts to generate rapid incident response investigation timelines.
ideas.title: DFIR Timeline & Memory Artifact Reconstructor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the high-intensity Digital Forensics and Incident Response (DFIR) category with hard engineering focused on automated parsing and timeline generation.

ideas.pitch: An educational hardware security dashboard that simulates stack-overflows and return-oriented programming (ROP) execution paths on a custom soft-core processor architecture.
ideas.title: RISC-V Pwnbox Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Brings together hardware design concepts and Pwn exploitation challenges, satisfying the desire for genuinely hard, low-level systems engineering.

ideas.pitch: A specialized defense-in-depth fuzzing and analysis pipeline targeting Web3 smart contracts to detect reentrancy and access control flaws before deployment.
ideas.title: Autonomous Smart Contract Bug Hunting Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages rigorous automated testing pipelines and security checks, directly appealing to judges evaluating Web3 and vulnerability detection.
